Caraboo is a general support that works on any team, and excels in Stall teams. Think Poison, Salvador, Vortice, Sanga as a couple examples.

Cetarchon works as a nuke. You wanna get hit for a ton, so you can hit them for a ton. It's a race to kill the enemy before you die. She works well with draw and Dmg Ups. Some characters that appreciate her are Casiah, Ramona, Ryker, Horla, and general supports like Saya, Arachne, Aigis.

Tawil can work as DPS/Support in Mono Chaos(at OE) and Aequor, or support for Vortice. In Mono Chaos, she turns one turn into 10 years with Hameln, or she works with 24 Posse Spam. In Aequor, she scales Tentacles and makes them slap a bunch of times with Wings + Red stance, alongside characters like Murphy, Caecus, Celeste. In Vortice, she works by generate Keyflare/Copy Cards/Utility for Insights and Wings/Exalting Often via Wings for Vortice Pursuit.

Leigh is your Healer and STR gen, that can generate quite some Embryos with a proper setup. However, she is very narrow as in other Awakener offer more. Seen in Doresain, Sorel, Uvhash as they appreciate the Healing based off Missing HP, due to their HP Loss Mechanics. Cantena as well, but Cantena often sticks with Aigis and Thais if possible.

Salvador is your Shielder/Healer/Weakness and Vuln App, your survivability and lifeline. He generates a bunch of Crimsum Furnace via his Skills, Enlightenments, and Exalt. Offering Weakness on his 3 cost, that also gives Furnace and Embryo Gen. His Exalt offers the Vuln. His 2 cost is used to manipulate health for Crimsum Furnace, and Shielding using Crimsum Furnace. Salvador scales overtime as well. At E0, his 2 cost End of Suffering, damage scales with every amount of Crimsum furnace generated throughout the battle. Same for his "Strike" at E1. His Defense gives more Furnace at E1. At E2, his 3 cost generates more Crimsum Furnace as battle prolongs. At E3, gains more Crit Dmg from Exalt, and OE gives him 2 cost even more dmg scaling and increases Furnace Cap. Thus allowing him to DPS over the course of a long fight.
Salvador works into any Stall, or Caro DPS comp.
He can work into any team that needs more survivability in general...
